install.uninstall: Disable and remove the bundle from the Plugins page, or dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove liarmttt-tavernweave-dsh.

evidence.notes: Accepted on DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (2026-10-18): plugin page metadata clean, TavernWeave X DSH preset selectable, 23 skills + Host Front Door loaded, Soul activation and a full-access terminal command verified. Known environment issue: workspace-write cannot provision a workspace inside a OneDrive reparse point; use full access or a normal local directory there.

knownEnvironmentIssues.scope: Windows DSH workspace located under a OneDrive reparse point (the tested workspace was a OneDrive-redirected directory)
knownEnvironmentIssues.symptom: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(<workspace>) for every pwsh call in workspace-write mode
knownEnvironmentIssues.diagnosis: diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl reports PRECONDITION/nextAction=stop: a reparse-point ancestor cannot be repaired through and the script refuses by design. Normal directories can be repaired: a verified grant on the SDK acceptance directory made pwsh Get-Location succeed afterwards.
knownEnvironmentIssues.workaround: Switch the preset session to full access (完全权限), or use a workspace on a normal local directory without a reparse-point ancestor; for normal directories run the bundled diagnostic once, then repeat the original confined operation.
